Subject: Post-call recap + request to schedule dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Karen —

Thanks again for the time this morning — really helpful to understand FinTechCo's realtime scoring use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary of requirements from discovery:
- Workload: realtime scoring for fraud/credit (inference-only)
- Concurrent users: ~120 (business-as-usual) with spikes for batch events
- Typical request: ~350 tokens input, 120 tokens output (avg)
- Steady-state throughput: ~8 requests/sec; spike up to ~35 RPS for peak windows
- Latency target: p95 under 250ms (ideally <200ms for critical flows)
- Data residency: US; no PII to leave VPC in Private deployments (noted)

Desired next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (30–45m) with our solutions engineer to map throughput/latency requirements to a Dedicated capacity recommendation (GPU type, pool size, batching strategy, KV cache sizing). I’ve attached our sizing template to capture the numbers beforehand (redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx).

Proposed times (PDT):
- Wed May 13, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed May 13, 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu May 14, 9:30–10:15am

If none of these work, please share 2–3 windows that are best for you and Mike and we’ll match. Alternatively, you can pick a slot directly here: https://cal.com/marissa/redwood-demo-30m

For the call we’ll aim to cover: throughput targets, expected token distributions, tolerance for batching (max latency impact), and a preliminary cost estimate for a Dedicated pool. 

CCing Dylan Brooks (solutions engineer) who will run the sizing and bring sample performance numbers for comparable models.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
